headline: Indianapolis gains a new set of downs
what_happened: D.Jones ran the ball up the middle for three yards on fourth down, which is the final chance to keep the ball before having to kick it away.
who: D.Jones ran the ball against G.Karlaftis and C.Jones.
why_it_matters: This is tough news for the Chiefs because it gives Indianapolis a fresh set of four tries to move closer to scoring. The Indianapolis win chance increased by 8 percentage points after this successful run.
